zip 4.6.1 is compiled only for Windows through tauri-plugin-updater 2.10.1 (no updater release accepts zip 9); the plugin unpacks an updater payload only after minisign verifies the whole download against the pubkey in tauri.conf.json, and Pulse's signed Windows payloads are NSIS/MSI installers, not zip archives. zip 4.6.1 applies SUID/SGID bits only under cfg(unix), and Windows has no setuid bits.
